description: Search Hepsiburada, browse category pages, or look up products. Collect prices, list prices, discounts, ratings, sellers, stock, shipping, installments, variants, specifications, and images.

brands.description: Exact brand names to include, e.g. Lenovo, Asus. Leave empty for all brands.
brands.title: Brands

discountedOnly.description: Keep only products Hepsiburada marks as advantageous or discounted.
discountedOnly.title: Discounted products only

fastDeliveryOnly.description: Keep only products with Hepsiburada's fast-delivery signal.
fastDeliveryOnly.title: Fast delivery only

includeProductDetails.description: Open each product page to add description, specifications, variants, stock count, seller rating, shipping cost, and return policy. One extra request per record.
includeProductDetails.title: Include full product details

maxItems.description: Maximum records per search query or category (1-2000). For product lookup it is the total across all URLs.
maxItems.title: Maximum items

maxPrice.description: Highest product price to include, in Turkish Lira.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (TRY)

maximizeCoverage.description: Split broad searches into price bands to go beyond the site's single-query result limit.
maximizeCoverage.title: Maximize coverage

minPrice.description: Lowest product price to include, in Turkish Lira.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (TRY)

minRating.description: Only include products rated at or above this many stars.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Choose keyword search, category browsing, or product lookup.
mode.title: What to scrape

officialSellersOnly.description: Keep only products from authorized or official sellers.
officialSellersOnly.title: Official sellers only

productUrls.description: Product page URLs, short product URLs, or bare product/SKU IDs (mode=productDetails).
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: One or more product searches (mode=search). Each query is collected separately.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sellers.description: Exact seller names to include, e.g. Hepsiburada. Leave empty for all sellers.
sellers.title: Sellers

sortBy.description: Result order for search and category modes.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Hepsiburada Scraper Input
